scope: 10 calibration cells only from frozen raw42fit/10cal/18dev cohort; no dev/test reads, no model construction/forward/fit
formula: s=t-20; implied_drop=(SOH_s-.8)*20/exp(mu_s); innovation=SOH_t-SOH_s+implied_drop. t>=120 with both saved origins. Visible through t only. .8 target fixed nominal1.1Ah endpoint.
assumption: Linear capacity path to endpoint is proxy hypothesis, not model-trained forecast or proof. Need observed-complete capacity after cycle.
outcome: retrospective trueRUL_t-exp(mu_t); unavailable online; forbidden as signal/update input
controls: model_only_implied_drop: catches algebraic association from saved predicted RUL
analysis: Within each cell Spearman rho; sign agreement and balanced sign agreement when both outcome signs present; then equal-cell summary, report all10 even one-sided. No p-values, bootstrap, thresholds optimized from labels or row-independent claims.
frozen_support_screen: At least5both-error-sign cells; equal-cell balanced sign>=.60, medianinnovationrho>=.20, >=7positive-rho cells, medianwithin-cellrhoincrement>=.05 over both observed-change and model-only controls. This is preliminary signal screen, not method acceptance or training GO.
public_scope: Protocol/code/aggregate cell diagnostic only, no raw curves or capacity-derived row CSV
failure: STOP preserves exact failed outputs; do not sweep horizon/thresholds/rescue screen
